name: Fontys University of Applied Sciences
summary: Hands-on university of applied sciences in Eindhoven, Tilburg and Venlo: small classes, company projects and internships.

ib.text: The IB Diploma is named as giving access. Many programmes also want satisfactory maths grades, engineering also physics or chemistry, with no IB grade set. An IB Diploma usually exempts you from an English test.

dates.label: Apply by 1 May for a September 2027 start; arts programmes differ
Fontys housing application due, September 2027 start

programmes.name: Applied Mathematics
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Mathematical modelling, programming and data science applied to real problems from companies, with AI used as a tool; two internships, and a data science specialisation from year 3.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Applied Physics
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths and physics; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Physics theory, lab experiments and projects on problems such as energy, hospital equipment and sound, in a small programme on the TU/e campus in Eindhoven.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Applied Science - Chemistry and Chemical Engineering
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths and chemistry; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Chemistry, chemical engineering and biology taught together as one toolkit for work on medicines, sustainable materials, clean water or diagnostics, in a small programme on the TU/e campus.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Automotive Engineering
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths and physics; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Mechanics, electronics and software applied to vehicles: you design, build and test them, with half a day a week in the workshop in year 1 before you choose a direction.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Circus and Performance Art
programmes.closesNote: Two audition videos due by 5 April 2027
programmes.ib: Audition: Studielink by 1 April 2027, two videos by 5 April, then a live audition in Tilburg on 18–20 May 2027.
programmes.about: Professional circus training with a flexible curriculum built around your own artistic goals, in a dedicated training hall in Tilburg with internationally qualified teachers.
programmes.selectionNote: Two videos by 5 April 2027 (online preselection); if selected, a live audition in Tilburg on 18–20 May 2027, and you must be there all three days.

programmes.name: Communication - International Communication Management
programmes.about: How organisations plan and manage communication across cultures and borders: communication strategy, intercultural understanding and working with people in diverse contexts.
programmes.ib: No subjects required beyond the IB Diploma.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Dance - Dance Arts in Context
programmes.ib: Audition for one profile: Studielink by 1 March, material by 4 March, live audition in Tilburg 19–22 April 2027, plus a medical test.
programmes.about: Contemporary, contemporary urban or choreography: you develop your own dance style and choreographic skills and explore current trends, in an international setting in Tilburg.
programmes.selectionNote: Online preselection (material by 4 Mar 2027) for one profile; if selected, a live audition in Tilburg on 19–22 Apr 2027 and a medical test. No online option.

programmes.name: Electrical and Electronic Engineering
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Designing the electronics inside devices, from patient monitors to electric cars and energy systems, with a focus on sustainable solutions.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Finance & Control
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths and economics (Fontys also names business economics); no IB grade is set.
programmes.about: Finance, accounting, risk management and strategic decision-making for businesses, with company projects and classes of at most 30 in Venlo. Formerly International Finance & Control.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: ICT: Information & Communication Technology
programmes.about: A broad ICT bachelor's: a common start, then one of 13 specialisations such as AI, cyber security or software development, built on real-life projects.
programmes.ib: No subjects required beyond the IB Diploma.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Industrial Design Engineering
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Product design covering form, use, function, production and market value, with sustainability and social impact built in, through design assignments with companies in Venlo.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Industrial Engineering and Management
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths; Fontys sets no IB grade.

separateFrom.name: Industrial Design Engineering
separateFrom.reason: A different subject (engineering management, not product design), taught in Eindhoven, not Venlo.

programmes.about: Improving and managing the processes of technical organisations, with projects for Brainport companies such as ASML and Philips and a personal coach throughout.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Information Technology
programmes.about: Software and AI development in teams for real clients: you analyse complex problems and build digital solutions, with attention to people and society, in Venlo.
programmes.ib: No subjects required beyond the IB Diploma.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: International Business
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in one of maths, economics or business economics; no IB grade is set.
programmes.about: A BBA covering international business, culture, marketing, finance, supply chain and HR, with classmates from across the world, in Eindhoven or Venlo.

needs.note: Any one of these; Fontys also names business economics.

programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Logistics Engineering
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Logistics processes, data analysis and teamwork, with internships and company projects from the start in Venlo; prepares you for engineer or analyst roles.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Logistics Management
programmes.about: Preparation for management roles in logistics, with a focus on sustainability and data, internships and projects, and a personal mentor, in Venlo.
programmes.ib: No subjects required beyond the IB Diploma.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Marketing Management

separateFrom.name: Marketing Management - Digital Business Concepts
separateFrom.reason: Venlo, without the Digital Business Concepts specialisation; the Tilburg version records an intake conversation on your economics background.

programmes.about: Market analysis, consumer behaviour, online channels, sales and product development, with two six-month internships worldwide and classes of at most 30 in Venlo.
programmes.ib: No subjects required beyond the IB Diploma.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Marketing Management - Digital Business Concepts
programmes.ib: Economics, business or management courses required; if yours fall short, an intake conversation looks at catching up before you enrol.

separateFrom.name: Marketing Management
separateFrom.reason: A different specialisation (Digital Business Concepts) in Tilburg, not Venlo, and only this one records an intake conversation that checks your economics background.

programmes.about: A mix of digital, marketing and business: you learn to design, develop and market digital products and business models with data, on assignments from companies, in Tilburg.

needs.note: Fontys asks for courses in economics, business and/or management.

programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; an intake talk follows if your economics is short.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths and physics; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Applying physics to design and build mechanical systems, structures and machines, with in-depth study of materials, lab work and industry projects.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Mechatronics
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths and physics; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Designing control systems for robot-controlled products and machines, mixing mechanical, electrical and software engineering in projects, in Eindhoven or Venlo.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Medical Imaging and Radiation Therapy
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths (Fontys checks your level); physics recommended; no IB grade is set.
programmes.about: Training to work with medical imaging and radiation therapy equipment: anatomy, imaging studies, radiation safety and patient care, in small classes in Eindhoven.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Music - Conservatory of Music Tilburg
programmes.closesNote: A second upload round closes 1 May
programmes.ib: Audition and theory test: upload by 1 March 2027 (auditions 15–19 March) or 1 May 2027 (24–28 May); online interview if you live outside NL or Belgium.
programmes.about: Classical or jazz music in a broad musical context, with teachers active on the music scene and ensemble projects that connect you with professionals, in Tilburg.
programmes.selectionNote: Upload audition material by 1 Mar or 1 May 2027; if selected, an online interview (outside NL/Belgium) or live audition, plus an online theory test.

programmes.name: Physiotherapy
programmes.about: All aspects of physiotherapy, from treating injuries to preventing them, with anatomy, neurology and physiology, hands-on practice and real patients, in small classes.
programmes.ib: No required subjects; Fontys recommends biology, English and maths.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

notes: If you miss 1 May, most programmes still take EEA applicants until the final deadline (1 or 15 August), but with fewer housing options.
Eleven of these bachelor's, including Automotive, Mechanical Engineering, ICT and Finance & Control, can also start in February; apply before 15 November for that.
Circus, Dance and Music in Tilburg select by audition, with deadlines months before 1 June.
